contradicting_evidence: Stablecoin supply contracted over both 7d and 30d, giving downside pressure a broader basis than a single intraday observation.
Settled BTC and ETH ETF outflows, widespread altcoin losses and declining ETH/BTC jointly support a plausible persistent-downside scenario.
There is no observed durable recovery sequence to offset those downside signals.
frozen_forecast.expected_path: Early weakness remains plausible, but the evidence does not reliably distinguish continued contraction from a rebound after deleveraging over a full week. A recovery case would require sustained price repair, stronger ETH/BTC, broader participation and improving demand evidence. No turning day, numeric path or week-end target is supported.
falsification_conditions: A sustained sequence of lower prices, persistently weak participation and newly observed adverse flows establishes a clearer downside edge.
Durable price recovery accompanied by sustained ETH/BTC strength, broader participation and improving capital-flow evidence establishes a clearer upside edge.
Any apparent recovery fails across repeated observations, resolving the present uncertainty toward renewed contraction.
missing_evidence: A multi-session price and breadth history sufficient to distinguish a persistent trend from a temporary dislocation.
Subsequent settled ETF sessions and updated liquidity observations showing whether current pressures persist or reverse.
Source-qualified evidence of broader altcoin recovery; longer-window altseason scores do not establish prospective weekly transmission.
supporting_evidence: Observed selling pressure coexists with localized BTC bid support, closes above hourly lows and ETH deleveraging; these do not resolve the weekly endpoint.
The supplied positive microstructure observations are too localized to establish recovery, while the current decline alone does not establish a full-week continuation.
Altseason readings are between published thresholds, providing no clear broad-rotation regime signal that resolves the forecast.
